headline: AI Data Center Backlash Grows as Public Opposition Surges
summary: Rising public backlash against data centers exposes fractures between AI boosters, skeptics, and populists on both left and right.

A year ago, just 42% of Americans opposed a data center being built in their community.

Today, a staggering 75% do.

Are data centers really that bad? Let’s take a look.
The American people — not a handful of billionaires — should decide the future of AI.
